fix_summary: §0/§7.1: 'k/N × dense' compute claim corrected to 'k × single expert-FFN, independent of N', matching §7.1 derivation.
§0/§2.1 table: Qwen3-MoE split out as top-8/128 (no shared); DeepSeek-V2 corrected to 6 routed+2 shared (was miswritten as +1); DeepSeek-V3 kept at 8 routed+1 shared.
§0/§6.2: 'V3 drops aux loss' softened to 'bias is primary, tiny sequence-wise aux loss remains as backstop'.
§2.2: Σf_i·P_i 'uniform = global minimum' claim corrected — uniform is only a self-consistent fixed point (counterexample N=2 added); Q3 answer aligned.
§2.3: Expert Choice '不丢 token' corrected to '不会 expert overflow' + token-side 0-hit caveat.

§2.4/§3.1/§6.1: DeepSeek-V3 biased-score formula corrected — bias is added AFTER sigmoid (s_i=σ(u_t·e_i) is already the affinity), not to raw pre-sigmoid logits; gating renormalizes the un-biased affinity directly (no second sigmoid); added missing routed_scaling_factor≈2.5 note in formula, code comments, and the §6.1 architecture diagram.
§2.5 (NEEDS_NUANCE): noisy top-k's purpose reframed as exploration + differentiable load-estimate proxy, not 'softening TopK itself to be differentiable'.

§4.2: 'Token Drop vs Residual Bypass' reframed as the same mechanism (not two alternative routes) under standard residual connections; added note that Mixtral/DeepSeek-V3 are dropless in practice and modern grouped-GEMM/block-sparse EP kernels don't require a hard capacity; Q4 answer aligned.

§4.3: Z-loss mislabeled as 'entropy regularizer' corrected to the log-partition stabilization term (cites §10 Q24's correct definition); 'enlarge capacity factor to punish collapse' removed as a false fix (enlarging capacity only reduces drops, does not punish concentration).

§4.4: gradient-w.r.t.-excluded-logit claim corrected from 'indirectly nonzero via softmax coupling' to exactly zero (full derivation showing the global partition function cancels, leaving a local top-k-only softmax); aligned with §10 Q12; fixed the original formula's misplaced indicator on the ∂Z/∂s_l term.

§6.3: Node-Limited Routing's 'each node capped at 3 experts' fabricated constraint removed; replaced with the actual mechanism (score 8 nodes by grouped top-(K_r/M) affinity sum, pick top-4 nodes, then global top-8 over their union).
§7.3: 'V3 KV cache ~5% of LLaMA-3-70B' corrected to ~21% (LLaMA-3-70B already uses GQA, not MHA; the 93.3% figure is MLA-vs-MHA, a different baseline, per §5).

§9.1/Q10: 'MoE has a bandwidth advantage at same active params' inverted claim corrected — the real advantage is MoE vs a same-total-params fully-active dense baseline, not same-active; capacity-ceiling table row also fixed (MoE has higher, not lower, ceiling at same active params).
Q18: '8×H100 minimum for V3' corrected — 8×80GB=640GB < 671GB required, does not fit; actually needs 9+ cards, in practice 16×H100 or 8×H200 (matches §7.2 table).

Q20: Mixtral 8x7B parameter breakdown replaced with an exact derivation (hidden=4096, ffn=14336, SwiGLU, 32 layers) giving 46.70B total / 12.87B active, matching official 46.7B/12.9B without a vague 'router weight' fudge factor.
Appendix: Switch Transformers citation year corrected from '(2021) JMLR' to '(2022) JMLR, arXiv preprint 2021' (conflated preprint and formal-publication years).
